scope: Exact cubical incidence checks the full signed Hessian expansion, bilinear error and finite deficit bound. Independent radius-two SU(2) matrix derivatives check every original one-face Hessian block. Spectral diagnostics check the full-source correction, inverse/Cauchy inequality and direct physical-window receiver. The original tent constants and denominator derivative are checked independently. These are algebraic diagnostics, not original Yang-Mills vacuum values.
